title: Grant report layout override permissions for non-SUPER users
summary: The Reporting - Edit permission set now grants necessary permissions for non-SUPER users to override extension-installed report layouts without encountering permission errors.
key_points: Adds RIMD permissions for Tenant Report Layout Override table to Reporting - Edit permission set
Resolves IndirectInsert permission errors when non-SUPER users attempt to change extension-installed layouts
Aligns the standard user-permission set with existing report-layout table permissions
Platform entitlement already supported the override table; this fills the user-permission gap
No schema or data changes required
quote: Add RIMD permissions for `Tenant Report Layout Override` to the System Application's `Reporting - Edit` permission set, matching the existing report-layout tables.
